propositions: CodeQL reports two high-severity py/incomplete-url-substring-sanitization alerts on lines 249–250 in test_llm_fallback_chain.py due to startswith() prefix checks against hardcoded URL constants
The startswith() pattern on a URL string is unsafe because it accepts hosts that share the prefix but differ in authority (e.g. https://fallback.test.evil.example/ passes but should not)
The assertion logic must compare URL origin (scheme, netloc tuple) by exact equality rather than substring prefix matching to eliminate the CodeQL alert and strengthen the test
The test property—that a fallback model is built against the configured endpoint and not the provider default—must remain validated after the fix
A host sharing the endpoint prefix as a substring must not satisfy the corrected assertion, and the configured endpoint value must be single-sourced to prevent drift
